original_complete_fact.claim: HandlerHashSymbol uses a keyed handler first then conditional insertion order. get/add/trigger normalize a non-Symbol responding to id, not arbitrary strings; add replaces a key, copy resolves and shares the current handler object. trigger passes normalized id first; absent handler yields nil. Ability/Item subclasses resolve registry records.
original_complete_fact.scope: Only cited complete units/explicit text ranges; no whole-foreign-file credit.

actual_complete_meaning: 原get/add/trigger都规范化和子类resolve registry两处陈述不能原样采用。查找[]与trigger仅把非Symbol且respond_to id的输入换成其id；任意String不to_sym。add直接保存原sym键，不做该转换；addIf的sym是条件条目的登记键，匹配在后续查找依插入序进行。
AbilityHandlerHash/ItemHandlerHash是空子类，没有GameData.get/try_get覆盖；lookup优先直接真值handler，再首个满足条件的addIf，未命中nil。copy即时解析当前handler对象并共用，不是后续动态别名。remove只删直接hash，clear才清两类。
无handler的trigger返回nil，调用时normalized id在参数首位；回调自身异常没有统一捕获。正式注册/复制以符号键的既有用法不被这份证据更正改动，不从内部Hash工具事实要求未来API。
